title: factdiff.py detect decides a Learn page that maps to a public MicrosoftDocs repository by that repository's git history, and fetches only the changed pages
goal: factdiff.py detect, for a learn.microsoft.com source whose page maps through census.py's LEARN_MAP to a file in a public MicrosoftDocs repository, fetches that repository once into the shared blobless clone cache and decides the source unchanged when the file has no commit since the baseline, with no HTTP request to Learn; only mapped sources with commits since, and unmapped ones, take the HTTP route; the map lookup is shared between census.py and factdiff.py, not copied. The detect wall time of a full --sitemaps run (about 45 minutes today, most of it Learn at one request per 1.1 s) is measured before and after on the same day and recorded in kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md with the command that measured it.

gates.question: When detect decides a mapped Learn page unchanged by its file's git history, does the stored detected_utc move up to the run time (as a 304 does), or stay at the older baseline day?
options: Move detected_utc up to the run time (as a 304 does): the file had no commit since the old day, so the text equals the baseline text and the next history read stays short
Keep the older detected_utc: history is read from the day of the last fetched text
gates.recommendation: Move detected_utc up to the run time (as a 304 does): the file had no commit since the old day, so the text equals the baseline text and the next history read stays short
gates.answer: Move detected_utc up to the run time (as a 304 does): the file had no commit since the old day, so the text equals the baseline text and the next history read stays short

gates.question: What does the fact diff log's signal column say for a Learn page decided by its file's git history: git (as for a wiki page) or a new name?
options: git: the same value a github.com wiki page or repository home gets when its clone decides it, so the log and census confirm text name one signal for history in a clone
learn-git: a value of its own that tells the Learn route from the github.com one
gates.recommendation: git: the same value a github.com wiki page or repository home gets when its clone decides it, so the log and census confirm text name one signal for history in a clone

notes: Premise: .claude/skills/kb-census/SKILL.md phase 0 gives factdiff.py detect --sitemaps about 45 minutes at one request per 1.1 s per host, Learn being most of it; 1395 of 2990 live sources are learn.microsoft.com on 2026-10-10. census.py check already decides a mapped Learn page by commits in its MicrosoftDocs repository (LEARN_MAP, _tools/census.py:69), so the map exists and the clone cache is shared; factdiff.py does not use it. The before figure is measured at the start of the work on the same day as the after figure, not taken from the skill's estimate. A request against a public repository by git over https stays read-only and pins nothing. Orchestrator note 2026-10-10: a full detect --sitemaps run takes about 45 minutes, longer than one foreground command may run (10 minutes); start it with nohup writing its output to the scratch directory, wait on its pid with foreground loops of under 10 minutes each, and end it before you return. A live detect run rewrites kb/public/_fetch_state.csv and snapshots: restore them from HEAD before committing (the measurement goes to kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md only).
